recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆淋巴球體積較大，細胞質豐富淡藍色，下方那顆的細胞質邊緣嗜鹼性加深並貼附擠壓周圍紅血球，核呈凹陷或腎形、染色質較鬆，是反應性（variant）淋巴球的特徵。
features: Two enlarged lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia with scalloped borders indented by adjacent red cells
Indented to reniform nuclei with moderately condensed, slightly open chromatin
No distinct nucleoli or cytoplasmic granules
Background normochromic red cells and adequate platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two enlarged lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm that deepens in basophilia toward the periphery and is scalloped around adjacent red cells. Nuclei are indented to reniform with moderately condensed chromatin and no prominent nucleoli. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with reactive (variant) lymphocytes, as seen in viral infections such as infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and folded lacy nuclei, without red cell-hugging basophilic borders.
Neoplastic lymphocytes form a monotonous population with nuclear clefts or nucleoli, whereas reactive forms show a spectrum of sizes.
Blasts have fine chromatin with nucleoli and a high N:C ratio rather than abundant cytoplasm.
